newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: YPF to supply gas to new Enron plant in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: YPF to supply gas to new Enron plant in Brazil.

text.p: Argentine oil giant YPF said Wednesday it would supply natural gas to a new electricity plant Enron plans to build in Mato Grosso, Brazil.
The plant will generate 480 megawatts and will need 2.5 million cubic meters of natural gas a day.
YPF estimated it would begin to ship Enron the gas in July, 1999, and continue to supply it for the next 19 years.
The Enron plant will be the first that runs on natural gas in the region and will require an investment of $500 million, YPF said.
The undertaking includes a 618-kilometer gas pipeline that will link up with the Bolivia-Brazil pipeline that will start to be built this year, and in which Enron also has a stake.
